The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

# THE FABRIC BEHIND THE GRAPHICS

Fisher Textiles has supplied engineered fabrics for digital textile printing since 1988. Our
award-winning knit and woven fabrics support dye sublimation, UV, Latex, and solvent printing for
applications ranging from trade shows to retail lightboxes, with widths up to 197 inches.

[LEARN MORE][16]

# RECYCLING PROGRAM

Our best-selling fabrics are available in recycled fabrics made from post-consumer PET bottles. We
also offer a fabric recycling program that repurposes used signage into new fiber-based
products—helping reduce landfill waste and move the signage industry toward a more circular future.

## New products

## GF 6099 Backed Crazier Cloth – Dye Sublimation Printable

][24]

GF6099 Backed Crazier Cloth is our premium polyester suede for custom pool tables and gaming table
applications. It has a 40-gram laminated backing to control ball speed and is comparable to Crazy 8.

$0.00
[Sample Request][25]
[

## GF 6099 Crazier Cloth – Dye Sublimation Printable

][26]

GF6099 Crazier Cloth is a premium sueded knit polyester fabric engineered for durable, high-quality
gaming table and upholstery applications. Its soft, brushed surface delivers a comfortable, elevated
feel, while its knit construction provides excellent resilience for long-term use. Winner of the
PRINTING United Alliance 2026 Award for Media – Textile – Upholstery.

$0.00
[Sample Request][27]
[

## DD 6760 Radiance – Transfer, Direct Dye Sub, and UV-Curable

][28]

DD 6760 Radiance is a next-gen woven backlit fabric with exceptional printability and ease of use.
Radiance is soft and smooth, with proven performance with both transfer and direct inline dye
sublimation print technologies. Its stable construction also allows for excellent results on
roll-to-roll or flatbed UV cure printers.

$0.00
[Sample Request][29]

We operate eight locations to better serve our customers. Our headquarters near Charlotte, NC stocks
all materials and handles samples and custom roll orders. Additional distribution centers in
California, Nevada, Ontario (Canada), Texas, and Wisconsin stock popular products and ship on our
behalf—helping reduce shipping costs and delivery times. Nevada and Texas locations ship by skid
load only.

## OUR STORY

Beaver Paper is a globally recognized producer of TexPrint® sublimation paper, ProTex™ tissue and
TexStyles® graphic fabrics for the dye-sublimation and digital print industry. With 40 years of
experience, Beaver Paper offers the most comprehensive product portfolio of sublimation media for
use in a variety of applications.

#### SUBLIMATION SOLUTIONS

As a leader in sublimation technology, Beaver Paper offers the widest range of innovative,
comprehensive sublimation solutions in the world.

#### RESPONSIBLY PRODUCED

From sustainable raw materials to 100% recyclable finished goods, Beaver Paper has the future
covered.

#### GET WHAT YOU NEED

We make it easy to get exactly what you need, when you need it, by keeping more stock on-hand, ready
to ship, than anyone else.

###### About DigiTex

## DigiTex Paper

#### Revaluation in the Printing


Dye sublimation printing is not only growing rapidly, but the efficient production technology of
digital dye sublimation printing has become almost indispensable for many industries. Especially in
textiles, makers of sportswear and fashion are looking for increased speed and improved quality to
meet the challenging demands of digitally printed garments. Suppliers in the fields of photo gifts,
merchandise and personalized items, especially with rigid substrates, demand pin-sharp and brilliant
image quality.

DIGITEX sublimation paper is impressively fast, efficient, and precise in every detail. It is the
ultimate choice for printing houses of any size that consistently want to deliver outstanding
quality. Our sublimation paper, with its future-proof technology, will help printers to impress
their clients with amazing results, enabling stable production and consistent quality.

###### Why Choose Us

## Why People Choose Our Sublimation Paper?

Digitex Paper is leading role in the digital sublimation industry where innovation is crucial.
Digital sublimation printing is a spectacular innovation in the digital graphic industry. The
possibilities of this technology stimulate a variety of new applications. Our paper guarantees
impressive reliability of the colour rendering and the sharpness of patterns as well as a high level
of run ability and transfer yield. It allows printing companies to achieve consistent quality,
brilliant colour and geometric patterns for their collections – resulting in satisfied end
consumers.

Digitex Paper uses the most advanced coating. The paper is designed to release the dyestuff from the
ink as much as possible during the sublimation process, resulting in brilliant colors. This makes
the high ink load possible that is needed to meet the specific requirements of the business. Based
its knowledge of paper and coatings, Digitex Paper has developed specific paper per application to
support your printing needs.

Our papers are equipped with special coatings which enable you to transfer 97% of the ink on to
polyester textiles. This results in a substantial ink reduction. The coating is applied inline.
Digitex Paper can therefore guarantee consistent and calibrated colors for each different run.

## iPromote Removes the Margin Obstacles that Stop Most from Selling Ads

Small and mid-sized businesses expect and need omnichannel execution. Search, social, programmatic
display, connected TV, and more.
Delivering it in-house means stacking specialists working across multiple platforms and burning
hours on low-budget campaigns where profit quietly disappears.

### We Built iPromote to Change That

Staffing overhead that scales faster than revenue
Every new channel demands a new certified specialist. Every new client multiplies the workload.
Senior talent is expensive to hire, slow to ramp, and impossible to fully utilize on SMB-sized
budgets. iPromote lets you scale seamlessly with no extra overhead cost.
Platform fragmentation across every client account
Google, Meta, TikTok, connected TV, and much more. Managing them across dozens, or hundreds, of
client accounts is operationally crushing before you’ve even optimized a single campaign. iPromote
has full omnichannel advertising capabilities in one platform.
Shrinking margins on the campaigns you already run
Platform fees, creative production, reporting cycles, and QA leave little leftover. On small-budget
campaigns, fulfillment margin often goes negative. iPromote keeps reporting in one dashboard and a
production cycle that takes minutes, not weeks.

## The Solution: One Omnichannel Fulfillment Platform

iPromote consolidates every paid media channel your clients need into a single fulfillment platform
— fully white-labeled, partner-ready, and engineered for margin. You stay on the strategy, the
pitch, and the client relationship. We handle the execution your team shouldn’t have to staff for.

### **The paid media platform that powers your front-end growth.**

Paid Search (SEM)
Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, and Yelp campaigns built to include keyword strategy, bid
management, negative keyword hygiene, and conversion tracking.
Paid Social
Meta and TikTok are the most popular channels on the web. Creative production, audience targeting,
placement optimization, and cross-platform reporting — in one workflow.
Programmatic Display & Video
Premium inventory across the most trafficked websites and streaming platforms. Display, native,
online video, and connected TV (OTT/CTV), all built based on each individual business and their
advertising goals.
Local & Targeted Media
Hyper-local reach for multi-location and small-market SMBs with location-specific targeting. The
channels small businesses ask for and many fulfillment partners don’t offer.
Creative & Landing Pages
On-platform creative production, landing page builds, and ongoing iteration, all built in minutes.
Your clients get the assets they need to perform without you hiring designers or developers.
Unified Reporting & White-Label Dashboards
Real-time, cross-channel performance dashboards delivered under your brand, logo, and colors. One
login. One source of truth. Clients see only you.

## Three steps. Every channel. Every client.

### Build

You bring the customers. Our platform, powered by AI-assisted media planning and a team of
advertising experts — builds a full omnichannel campaign structure across every relevant channel in
minutes, not weeks. Audiences, creative, targeting, budget pacing, and conversion events are
configured before launch.

### Launch

Campaigns go live in 2 business days, on every channel simultaneously. No platform-by-platform
handoffs. No specialist bottlenecks. Your clients see activity, you see revenue, and your team gets
back to selling the next engagement.

### Optimize

iPromote’s cross-channel optimization engine continuously shifts budget, audiences, and creative
toward what’s performing best. So you’re never siloed inside a single platform’s view. The result:
better ROAS for your clients, higher retention for your accounts, and a margin profile that finally
makes paid media worth selling.

## Why Partners Choose iPromote

Certified Platform Expertise
20+ years of success in the digital advertising space. Top-tier access and support without your team
doing the legwork.

#### FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

#### + [Is There A Minimum Order?][31]

There is no minimum order required! You can order as little as one sheet if needed.

#### + [What Is Your Turnaround Time?][32]

For most projects we can usually print the product in as little as one business day.

#### + [What Is Dye Sublimation?][33]

Dye-sublimation printing (or dye-sub printing) is an imaging process which uses heat to transfer dye
onto materials such as a synthetic fabrics (such as polyester), metals, glass and plastics.

#### + [Can You Sublimate Cotton?][34]

No. Organic fibers, such as cotton, do not accept the sublimation dyes. However, you can sublimate
popular blends such as 50/50 and 65/35. Only the polyester fibers will accept the dyes. So the
higher the percentage of poly, the brighter your graphic will be. If you use a 50/50, the resulting
image will have a washed out or faded look. Perfect for some types of graphics and not acceptable at
all for others. It just depends on your customer's expectations. Try our new **Sublimation
Simulator** for a virtual visualization of your actual artwork on various colors and fabrics!

#### + [Can You Print on Black or Darker Colors?][35]

Since there are no pure white sublimation inks, we can only dye the fabric darker. For example: if
you have a photo of a white poodle and you press it on a pink shirt, you will then have a pink
poodle. Try our new **Sublimation Simulator** for a virtual visualization of your actual artwork on
various colors and fabrics!

#### + [Is Dye Sublimation Better Than Screen Printing?][36]

Dye sublimation is considerably more durable than screen printing because you will actually dye the
fabric instead of melting plastic on top of it. The resulting image will not crack, peel or fade.
There is absolutely no feel or "hand" to the printed graphic. Dye sublimation also allows for more
intricate designs and colors to be used. You can print full color graphics, even photos with no
additional costs.

#### FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

#### + [Is There A Minimum Order?][31]

There is no minimum order required! You can order as little as one sheet if needed.

#### + [What Is Your Turnaround Time?][32]

For most projects we can usually print the product in as little as one business day.

#### + [What Is Dye Sublimation?][33]

Dye-sublimation printing (or dye-sub printing) is an imaging process which uses heat to transfer dye
onto materials such as a synthetic fabrics (such as polyester), metals, glass and plastics.

#### + [Can You Sublimate Cotton?][34]

No. Organic fibers, such as cotton, do not accept the sublimation dyes. However, you can sublimate
popular blends such as 50/50 and 65/35. Only the polyester fibers will accept the dyes. So the
higher the percentage of poly, the brighter your graphic will be. If you use a 50/50, the resulting
image will have a washed out or faded look. Perfect for some types of graphics and not acceptable at
all for others. It just depends on your customer's expectations. Try our new **Sublimation
Simulator** for a virtual visualization of your actual artwork on various colors and fabrics!

#### + [Can You Print on Black or Darker Colors?][35]

Since there are no pure white sublimation inks, we can only dye the fabric darker. For example: if
you have a photo of a white poodle and you press it on a pink shirt, you will then have a pink
poodle. Try our new **Sublimation Simulator** for a virtual visualization of your actual artwork on
various colors and fabrics!

#### + [Is Dye Sublimation Better Than Screen Printing?][36]

Dye sublimation is considerably more durable than screen printing because you will actually dye the
fabric instead of melting plastic on top of it. The resulting image will not crack, peel or fade.
There is absolutely no feel or "hand" to the printed graphic. Dye sublimation also allows for more
intricate designs and colors to be used. You can print full color graphics, even photos with no
additional costs.

  Description
  
  Printing with eco-solvent, latex or UV wide format inks? Look to Nekoosa for an extensive
  portfolio of pressure sensitive vinyls, specialty print media, overlaminates, mounting films and
  barrier films used to produce general signage and window, wall and floor graphics on wide and
  grand format printers.

Copy

The partnership of Nekoosa Coated Products, RTape, Catalina Graphic Films, and CET Films allows
Nekoosa to deliver excellence individually and create new growth opportunities working as one. Our
expertise spans coating, converting and custom plastic extrusion capabilities, with a product
offering that includes application tapes, pressure-sensitive films, specialty synthetics, carbonless
paper and capping films.

Copy

The lineage of Nekoosa’s experience in the specialty media industry dates back to 1961. What began
as a division of 3M, focusing on carbonless paper, has grown into a multi-faceted company of key
brands: Nekoosa Coated Products, RTape, Catalina Graphic Films, Mojave Digital Media, and CET Films;
with a constant desire to expand our product portfolio.

# Modern software.
# Built to perform.

PaperMC improves Minecraft's ecosystem with fast, secure software and an expanding plugin API,
providing quick releases and helpful support as the most widely used, performant, and stable
software available.

[ Downloads ][11][ Documentation ][12]
$

## Your server deserves the best.

[

### Paper

Paper is a Minecraft game server based on Spigot, designed to greatly improve performance and offer
more advanced features and API.

][13][

### Velocity

Velocity is a high-performance, scalable Minecraft proxy server that allows players to connect to
multiple Minecraft servers under the proxy.

][14][

### Folia

Folia is a new fork of Paper that adds regionized multithreading to the server allowing for better
performance and scalability.

][15]

## A diverse plugin ecosystem

Crafted by the PaperMC team & contributors, Hangar is our own dedicated plugin repository, now in
open beta! A place for developers to host their creations, and server owners to enrich their
player's gameplay. From Administration Tools, to Minigames, you'll find it all on Hangar.

[ Check out Hangar ][16]

## Powering players

PaperMC's software powers hundreds of thousands of Minecraft servers on a daily basis, from small
single-servers setups to massive Minecraft server networks. Designed with utility and performance in
mind, it can handle whatever you throw at it.

## The promise of stability

Our software is designed with security and stability in mind. We have consistently been among the
first to fix vulnerabilities in the Minecraft space for years, so you can rest assured that PaperMC
software is a good choice.

# Roll with us

At Pritchard Paper Products we convert all of our own papers allowing you direct access to the most
competitive pricing available. With eight paper rewinding machines, many of them state of the art
high-speed pieces of equipment we are capable of converting tens of millions of lineal feet per
month. Specializing in sewn products we convert many grades of plotter papers, separating tissues,
perforated krafts, underlay papers, pattern papers, marking papers & poly overlays for manufacturers
in the apparel, furniture, and automotive upholstery industries, as well as uniforms & military.
Roll with us, you’ll be happy you did.

The variety of applications our technology can deliver is only limited by the creativity of the
user. With the ability to print on hard or soft surfaces, our digital sublimation transfer printing
services provides vivid, eye-catching results in every finished product. Pritchard Paper
additionally converts a full line of dye sublimation protection tissues that are used for the
blanket protection of rotary heat presses. Our tissues are capable of withstanding heavy ink
applications, and are ideal in the safeguarding against ghosting.

# S-RACE® sublimation paper – Taking sublimation printing into the future

Dye sublimation printing is not only growing rapidly, but the efficient production technology of
digital dye sublimation printing has become almost indispensable for many industries. Especially in
textiles, makers of sportswear and fashion are looking for increased speed and improved quality to
meet the challenging demands of digitally printed garments. Suppliers in the fields of photo gifts,
merchandise and personalized items, especially with rigid substrates, demand pin-sharp and brilliant
image quality.

S-RACE^{®} dye sublimation paper is impressively fast, efficient, and precise in every detail. It is
the ultimate choice for printing houses of any size that consistently want to deliver outstanding
quality. S-RACE^{® } sublimation paper, with its future-proof technology, will help printers to
impress their clients with amazing results, enabling stable production and consistent quality.

Therefore we promise: **S-RACE^{®} – made to impress**

# S-RACE® sublimation paper – Taking sublimation printing into the future

Dye sublimation printing is not only growing rapidly, but the efficient production technology of
digital dye sublimation printing has become almost indispensable for many industries. Especially in
textiles, makers of sportswear and fashion are looking for increased speed and improved quality to
meet the challenging demands of digitally printed garments. Suppliers in the fields of photo gifts,
merchandise and personalized items, especially with rigid substrates, demand pin-sharp and brilliant
image quality.

S-RACE^{®} dye sublimation paper is impressively fast, efficient, and precise in every detail. It is
the ultimate choice for printing houses of any size that consistently want to deliver outstanding
quality. S-RACE^{® } sublimation paper, with its future-proof technology, will help printers to
impress their clients with amazing results, enabling stable production and consistent quality.

Therefore we promise: **S-RACE^{®} – made to impress**

## Core Industrial Engineering Services

Choose the right consulting route based on your plant requirement: process improvement, audit, water
balance, treatment plant review, pollution-control documentation, impact assessment or Chartered
Engineer certification.

## Process Consulting

Project assessment, yield improvement, bottleneck review, project assessment and technical
doumentation.

Read More >

## Energy Audits

Electrical, thermal, HVAC, boiler, steam, utility and industrial energy cost-reduction studies.

Read More >

## Water Audits

Water Balance, consumption mapping, reuse planning, fresh water reduction and compliance support.

Read More >

## ETP/STP Review

Technical treatment design basis checks, troubleshooting, augmentation and performance review.

Read More >

## ZLD Consulting

ZLD, Feasibility, RO Reject Review, MEE/MVR planning, water recovery and cost realism.

Read More >

## Pollution control

SPCB notice response, CTE/CTO technical support, ETP/APCD review and corrective action planning.

Read More >

## Impact Assessment

Engineering Inputs for EMP, environmental documentation, expansion planning and project review.

Read More >

## Chartered Engineer

Used machinery import, EPCG, DGFT, Installation Certificates and project cost certificate.

lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

### Reliable Sublimation Supplies for Professional Results

We produce and export premium sublimation transfer paper, sublimation ink, and DTF materials backed
by over 15 years of research and manufacturing experience.

[Explore Products][20]
[Request a Quote][21]

### Quick Dry Sublimation Paper

Water-based fast-release paper in 29 – 120 gsm formats. Dries within 10 seconds and offers clear,
bright prints on polyester fabrics.

[Learn more][22]

### High Sticky Sublimation Paper

Tack-coated paper designed to hold fabric firmly during heat transfer. Prevents ghosting and
shifting, making it ideal for stretchy textiles and flatbed presses.

[Learn more][23]

### Original Epson Sublimation Ink (SureColor F-series)

Genuine MYCK ink for Epson SureColor F-series printers. Delivers rich color saturation and crisp
detail.

[Learn more][24]

### Dye Sublimation Ink

High-release, vivid, and wash-fast ink suitable for a wide range of print sizes, from small-scale to
large-format.

[Learn more][25]

### Large-Format Sublimation Paper Jumbo Roll

Fast-dry sublimation paper available in rolls from 17″ to 126″, perfect for industrial-scale
printing. Maintains uniform coating and smooth feeding.

[Learn more][26]

### Why Choose Us?

#### 15+ Years of R&D Excellence

Our dedicated research center has focused on transfer material development for over 15 years.

Custom packaging, branding, and product configurations are available.

#### Global Export Capabilities

Supplying businesses in over 100 countries with full documentation and fast shipping.

All products are manufactured and tested in-house for consistency and performance.

**About Us**

********Suzhou Long-term Digital Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in sublimation paper and DTF film
manufacturing. Our factory is equipped with high-speed coating machines, supporting a maximum width
of 3.2m and paper weight from 29g to 120g. Boasting over 10 years of sublimation paper production
experience and 8 years of international sales, we enjoy solid market credibility.
Our sublimation paper features quick drying, anti-curling and high transfer rate, with a monthly
output of 6,000 tons to guarantee fast order delivery. In 2021, we launched DTF film production,
with two professional coating lines achieving a monthly output of 2 million square meters. Our DTF
film stands out for easy peeling, vivid colors and stable quality. We also supply one-stop DTF
printing supplies and equipment, including printers, powder shakers, hot melt powder and special
inks.
Backed by an experienced overseas sales team, we offer premium service and competitive prices.
Located in Suzhou, just 60km from Shanghai, we sincerely welcome your visit and cooperation.

[New Taktiful/WhatTheyThink Embellishment Study Finds Demand on the Rise]

## New Taktiful/WhatTheyThink Embellishment Study Finds Demand on the Rise

In the latest Taktiful/WhatTheyThink 2026 Embellishment Study, two-thirds of users of digital
embellishment equipment said they have seen more demand for digital embellishments in the past year,
up from the 29% who said this in last year’s survey. Eighteen percent said demand has remained about
the same (down from 56% last year), and only 5% have seen less demand for embellishments, down from
9% last year. [Read More][24]

[(Re)introducing the Oliver Typewriter]

## (Re)introducing the Oliver Typewriter

Frank presents the 1895 Oliver Typewriter, the first typewriter that let you see what you were
typing as you typed. The original 1873 typewriter typed on the rear of the sheet. [Read More][25]

[Around the Web: Of Fonts and Files]

## Around the Web: Of Fonts and Files

Last month’s Typographics 2026 was a two-day conference devoted to type, language, and visual
culture. Ghost Font is an attempt to keep AI from stealing content. Inkjet printing can be used to
make inexpensive OLED displays. “What happens when a type foundry stops designing fonts as static
objects and starts designing them as living systems?” An art vending machine. An artist who makes
intricate sculptures out of paper. Germany’s the Kugelhaus was a spherical, six-story steel
building. The first person in England to use an umbrella was treated to insults and abuse. Graphene
oxide composite enables a flexible memristor for low-light artificial vision. “Weird Al” declined to
be an AI company’s spokesman. A 1,478-piece “X Files” LEGO set. Could wet coffee grounds be used to
generate cleaner sources of energy? Welcome to WhatTheyThink’s weekly miscellany. [Read More][26]

[Print Careers: Strategies for Attracting and Retaining Talent]

## Print Careers: Strategies for Attracting and Retaining Talent

It used to seem simple, but employee retention has been complicated by evolving lifestyle
preferences and increased competition. By fostering a culture that promotes loyalty and career
development, PSPs can build a strong team while also positioning themselves for long-term success.
In addition to discussing time-honored practices, this article explores innovative ways to attract
and retain a high-powered workforce. [Read More][27]

[Designers of the Next Decade: Spotlighting the Best in Print at New Designers 2026]

## Designers of the Next Decade: Spotlighting the Best in Print at New Designers 2026

New Designers held at the Business Design Centre in London each July brings the academic cohort
together as one community. For over 40 years, New Designers has served as the UK's most established
platform for graduate design talent—and the 2026 edition was no exception. It's an important element
of ensuring the next generation of design professionals. [Read More][28]

[Digital Embellishment Moves Beyond Decoration]

## Digital Embellishment Moves Beyond Decoration

In this installment of Taktiful...Thursday, Eric Vessels talks with Ed Wiegand, President and CEO of
JetFX Inc., about the business case for digital embellishment. Wiegand discusses his path from
labels and combination printing to launching JetFX, and explains how UV inkjet-based embellishment
can help printers and converters improve profitability, reduce waste, and create new opportunities
in fast-moving markets. [Read More][29]

[Fujifilm's New Inkjet Packaging Press]

## Fujifilm's New Inkjet Packaging Press

Mary Schilling talks in depth with Don Schroeder, Senior Director, Technical Sales, Digital
Packaging Solutions, Fujifilm North America Corporation, about the new J Press FP790 Inkjet Label
Packaging Press. [Read More][30]


The executive report looks back at 2025 and the first few months of 2026 and ahead to what the
industry can expect, economically and technologically, in the latter half of 2026 and into 2027 and
beyond.

The report includes current and expected business conditions, top business challenges, top business
opportunities, and planned investments for 2026.

ENQUIRY

# DYE
# Sublimation
# Paper

Spread across a big space of 2500 mtrs with one coating machine and two slitting machines, Zibo
Paper Tech came into existence in 2016. We are manufacturers and exporters of DYE Sublimation Paper.
We export to Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, and looking forward in global market. In just a year of
our operations we extended our operations in South India with a new new Dye Sublimation paper unit
at Erode by the name Champion Paper Industries.

Professional QC
Stringent inspection before dispatch
Direct factory supply Competitive pricing
Premium quality
Optimum after sale support

## Why choose us

### Strict Quality Control

We have over 10 workers cooperating on Quality control both for the original Material and finished
Goods. QC before delivery is also what we need for each order.

With the development and innovation time after time Zibo paper tech has possessed the intellectual
property that is the technique of dye sublimation paper with different gsm.

Papers coating will be balanced and treated to give a good quality of print on fast drying
sublimation paper and high amount of ink transfer on fabric.

Based on the spirit of company, pioneering, creation, honesty, development, confirmed the principle
of quality and credit, we will provide the finest product and perfect service to all clients

### One stop Solution

We offer a wide range of sublimation papers, from 8” (20.32cm) to 72” (182cm) in 40GSM to 105GSM.
Making you able to source all the items you need. We use standard paper from standard mills of
India. We use 2” and 3”core as per requirement of our client.

### Reasonable Pricing

We run our own coating factory, thus to offer the most reasonable pricing and give the most profit
to our clients.

### Responsible after sale service

As a responsible company, we never make any exercise for mistakes, clients come first, any complaint
is supposed to be settled in a responsible manner.

We believe in
just in time (JIT)

## Textile Applications

Dye sublimation printing is becoming increasingly important in the textile market, with application
ranging from fashion and sportswear over to home and soft signage.

# FASHION

T-Shirts • Shorts • Scarves • Dresses • Skirts • Blouses etc.

# SPORTSWEAR

Swim Trunks • Swim Suits • Bikinis • Sports Shirts • Sport Shorts • Tricots etc.

# HOME DECOR

Upholstery • Decorative Cushions • Curtains • Bed Linen •
Table Cloths etc.

# SOFT SIGNAGE

Banners • Flags • Displays • Exhibition Walls etc.
